text: just seen a lad on the 43 bus trying to learn german off a textbook. paper one. no app. no duolingo. no flashcards. no google translate. just him and a grammar table from 1998 at 8am on a wet tuesday. bookmark was a receipt. respect honestly.
base_video: Creator sitting on the top deck of a bus, hood up, phone propped at chest height, looking straight down the lens then glancing sideways at something off camera. Tiny eyebrow raise, no speaking.
audio: original audio, room tone with bus engine
caption: the receipt bookmark is what got me
why_this_brand: Learning German off a paper grammar table on a commute is exactly the ten-spare-minutes moment Duolingo owns.

text: i went to madrid for nine days. no duolingo. no phrasebook. no notes app vocab list. just me and three words i half remembered from year 8. ordered every single meal in english while apologising in english about it. came home saying i'd pick it up next time. couldn't be me. except it was me.
base_video: Creator sitting at a kitchen table or on a sofa, eating something slowly, staring at the camera with zero expression, one slow blink halfway through.
audio: slow sad trending sound, low volume
caption: nine days. three words. be honest, same?
why_this_brand: The holiday-booked learner freezing in Spanish and defaulting to English is Duolingo's core pain scene.

text: my flatmate signed up for an evening class at the college. forty minutes each way in the rain. no app on the bus there. no duolingo. no flashcards. no youtube videos. just her a whiteboard and six other adults conjugating verbs at half seven on a wednesday. she's built different and wrong.
base_video: Creator in a car in a dark car park, seatbelt on, engine off, rain on the windscreen. Looks at the camera, small head shake, looks back out the window.
audio: original audio, rain and room tone
caption: tag the one friend who does it the hard way
why_this_brand: Evening class at the local college is the expensive, abandonable old route Duolingo replaces with short lessons.

text: just seen my brother at his desk at 11pm getting ready to learn french. unopened grammar textbook. three paper flashcards he wrote in january. anki downloaded never opened. no duolingo. just him and a highlighter staring at page one like it owes him money. genuinely unwell behaviour.
base_video: Creator lying in bed in a dim room, phone above their face, slowly turning their head to the camera and holding a flat stare for the full clip.
caption: the january flashcards are the saddest part
why_this_brand: Untouched textbook, January flashcards and an unopened Anki are the exact graveyard of abandoned language study.

text: girl in the departure lounge at stansted buying a paper phrasebook for a week in italy. no app. no duolingo. no youtube grammar. no notes app list. just her and eighty laminated pages she's going to read once on the plane and never open again. hope she makes it honestly.
base_video: Creator sat in an airport seat or on a suitcase, backpack on, drinking a coffee, glancing at the camera between sips with a small knowing look.
caption: has the airport phrasebook ever worked for anyone
why_this_brand: The airport phrasebook panic-buy is the pre-holiday moment Duolingo's short lessons are built for.
